name: simplicity order with inverse
mechanism: map each bounded typed choice to a non-negative index within its constraint space and order sequences shortlex over those indices, with an inverse from index to value so the simplest value is constructible
fails_when: orders the encoding, not the decoded value
length-first rejects longer encodings of simpler values
